def total_minutes_across_days(day_count, time_str):
    colon = time_str.index(':')
    hours = int(time_str[:colon])
    minutes = int(time_str[colon + 1:])
    return day_count * 1440 + hours * 60 + minutes

def smallest_repeating_unit(s):
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        return ''
    doubled = (s + s)[1:-1]
    idx = doubled.find(s)
    period = idx + 1 if idx != -1 else n
    return s[:period]

    length = len(digits)
    if keep <= 0:
        keep = 0
    visible = digits[length - keep:] if keep > 0 else ''
    hidden_count = length - len(visible)
    return '*' * hidden_count + visible

import re

def sentence_case_keep_i(s):
    lowered = s.lower()
    replaced = re.sub(r'(?<!\S)i(?!\S)', 'I', lowered)
    match = re.search(r'[a-zA-Z]', replaced)
    if not match:
        return replaced
    i = match.start()
    return replaced[:i] + replaced[i].upper() + replaced[i + 1:]
